name: moderator_ray_checkerboard
description: Brick-offset checkerboard of two CRAY ray emitters (INSL and COAL) five columns apart, each column's cells offset one row from its neighbour -- a mixed moderating field cast across open space instead of a solid moderator block.
why: Read pixel-exact from save 1468603 (Deuterium Reactor v1.3): CRAY(ctype=INSL) at x=151 hits even relative rows and at x=156 hits odd rows; CRAY(ctype=COAL) at x=161 hits odd rows and x=165 hits even rows -- a genuine brick-laid alternation, not a uniform grid. None of the existing 30 modules or the other new registry modules use CRAY to cast a moderator field this way (the closest, cray_electric_tap, projects ELEC for power, not INSL/COAL for moderation).
source: save 1468603, x145-180 y4-20 (CRAY(INSL) at x=151/156, CRAY(COAL) at x=161/165, 2px row pitch)
